basic_info.description: Beautiful 3 unit bldg in sought after Inner Richmond. Top floor is a 3 bdrm, 2 bathrm unit that had been renovated with brand new kitchen and bathrooms. Both rear bedrooms have access to a deck over looking large backyard. Middle unit is also a 3 bedroom 2 bath unit occupied by tenants. Garden unit is a 1 bedroom unit with kitchen and living room. It has direct access to garden. Full size lot. Garage parks 1 car with storage. Location is awesome just a couple of blocks to shops, restaurants and farmers market on Clement street. Also close to Golden Gate park and public transpotations. Show by appointment only please. Some of the pictures a virtually staged and altered.
